_comment: This file lists the kinds of file a project of this core can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it. Each kind is called a slot. A project file records its files under the slot ids used here.

slots.title: Game
slots.help: The Game Boy or Game Boy Color game: the cartridge's contents, a .gb or .gbc file (.sgb for a Super Game Boy one).

slots.title: Saved data
slots.help: The cartridge's battery-backed memory at the start, for a project that begins from a saved game: a file as Emulator > Export Save Data... writes it, or a .sav file of Gambatte's or of another emulator. A cartridge with a clock keeps the clock's registers after the memory, as Gambatte writes them; a file without them starts the clock at zero. The file is never changed. Leave this empty to start with the cartridge's memory empty.
slots.nameHelp: a saved-data file is identified by its extension, .sav.
